author: reek
body: The page runtime compiles or loads a page, verifies its capability profile, and extracts the widget tree.

author: reek
body: Phase 1 (MVP): Built-in pages as inline functions. Local file loading via pre-compiled CDX. No in-browser compilation.

author: reek
body: Phase 2: Invoke the compiler pipeline in-process to compile page source to CDX, then extract the widget tree entry point.
